Class InteractionMessageTransmitters

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.interactionssequencediagram.InteractionMessageTransmitters
All Implemented Interfaces:
InteractionMessageUtility
public class InteractionMessageTransmitters extends Object implements InteractionMessageUtility
InteractionMessageTransmitters enable the transmission from the simulation to an interaction sequence display (sequence diagram) of the interaction messages that occur during the simulation. This implmentation of the SysMLPort's InteractionMessageUtility enables a grapical display of the real-time sequence diagram of the interactions between the specified parts of the model throughout the simulation.

The InteractionMessageTransmitters must be created and assigned to the messageUtility variable of the SysMLPort to perform its function. This creation/assignment should be performed in an overridden version of the SysMLPort's createInteractionMessageUtility() operation.

    • perform

      public void perform(Instant time, StateBehaviorContext contextBlock, SysMLSignal messageSignal, SysMLPort peerPort, Logger logger)
      Performs a transmission of interaction message data for a flow port transmission. Note this operation is automatically invoked by the SysMLPort if 1) the port's messageUtility is set to an instance of this class, and 2) the port is connected to another SysMLPort.
      Specified by:
      perform in interface InteractionMessageUtility
      Parameters:
      time - time of the interaction (message transmission)
      contextBlock - SysMLPart or SysMLPort in whose context this port resides, i.e. in which it is a port
      messageSignal - signal which contains the message
      peerPort - peer full port to which the message is transmitted
      logger - this full port's logger to be used for logging as needed

      /** Performs the actual transmission of an interaction message (in the form a a String between the specified proxy port and the specified context part called to a sequence diagram display.
